about: Shared identity cases. packages/ai/src/validators/identity.test.ts and evals/tests/test_graders_identity.py both check every case of every suite, so the validator and the grader cannot drift apart. 'flagged' and 'allowed' are typed text (the answer); the '_spoken' lists are what a call says aloud (CoachResponse.spoken), where case is not heard. 'addressees' are the founder and team names the reply may address.
